GameConditionDef.label: core collapse
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: A cataclysm deep within the planet has shattered its core, turning the surface into a frozen wasteland of unprecedented cruelty. No biological life can endure the brutal cold, and storms of ice rage endlessly.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: The planet’s inner core has ruptured—its dying embers stolen by the void. A deep freeze spreads outwards; you may never see warmth again…
GameConditionDef.endMessage: (This should never happen—Core Collapse is permanent.)
GameConditionDef.letterText: Core Collapse has begun. The world is now locked in perpetual ice and snow—prepare for total biological extinction.
